title: Completed Post-Implementation Review Report Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Post-Implementation Review Report artifact data payloads (PMO-07.05).

review_purpose_and_evaluation_period.description: The post-handover evaluation objectives and the operating timeframe assessed (typically 3 to 6 months post go-live).

lead_evaluator_and_date.description: The designated business assurance lead or PMO evaluator conducting the review and the completion date.

planned_vs_realized_benefits.description: Quantitative comparison of financial and operational benefits realized in steady-state operations versus business case projections.

operational_adoption_rate.description: Metrics reflecting user adoption, system throughput, and behavioral integration into routine operations.

operational_stability_and_support.description: Assessment of post-transition SLA adherence, support ticket volume, and operational maintenance handover efficacy.

outstanding_issues_and_technical_debt.description: Inventory of lingering operational bugs, unresolved defects, or technical debt requiring long-term maintenance.

strategic_lessons_learned.description: High-level strategic insights on solution viability, change management effectiveness, and business model impact.

ongoing_optimization_recommendations.description: Prescriptive guidance for continuous optimization, future phase enhancements, and long-term capability extension.
